facts.text: Spencer, I came in for a quiet life and now I'm an avatar again. At least feed me first.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Eddie's words, but he never says it. It is also off the plot, since Eddie has never been in the game before, so he can't be an avatar 'again'. His lines on the quote page are short, such as 'You still talking to your friends?'. Fridge has a real food line: 'I got killed by a piece of cake!'
facts.fix: "I got killed by a piece of cake!" (Fridge)

fix_note.text: I got killed by a piece of cake!

facts.text: Serve the mains when the friends get sucked back into the game.
facts.why: Spencer's friends follow him into Jumanji, and Eddie and Milo are pulled in too. Fits.
Eddie and Milo are estranged old friends and the film ends with Eddie at a restaurant. The diner is from the film, not the plot pages, but fits.
